dialogues.jp: それでも……。
dialogues.en: Even then......
dialogues.text: Even then......

dialogues.jp: ぐっ、と拳を握る。
dialogues.en: I made a fist.
dialogues.text: I made a fist.

dialogues.jp: 歯をくいしばる。
dialogues.en: I clenched my teeth.
dialogues.text: I clenched my teeth.

dialogues.jp: それでも俺は音夢を諦めきれない。
dialogues.en: I just can't forget about her.
dialogues.text: I just can't forget about her.

dialogues.jp: 「バカだよな俺……」
dialogues.en: "I'm such an idiot......"
dialogues.text: "I'm such an idiot......"

dialogues.jp: 明らかに間違った選択肢だろう。
dialogues.en: I know I'm making a mistake.
dialogues.text: I know I'm making a mistake.

dialogues.jp:
音夢の命が関わっているというのに、それなの
に……。
dialogues.en: Even though her life's at stake......
dialogues.text: Even though her life's at stake......

dialogues.jp: また同じことを繰り返してしまうのか。
dialogues.en: I can't forget about the small pain in my chest.
dialogues.text: I can't forget about the small pain in my chest.

dialogues.jp: だけど──。
dialogues.en: I can't forget about her warmth.
dialogues.text: I can't forget about her warmth.

dialogues.jp:
この胸の小さな痛みを忘れることなんて出来な
い。
dialogues.en: "Here you go."
dialogues.text: "Here you go."

dialogues.jp: 音夢の温かさを忘れることが出来ない。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「買って来たよ〜」
dialogues.en: "Oniichan, were you crying just now?"
dialogues.text: "Oniichan, were you crying just now?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おぅ」
dialogues.en: "What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "What are you talking about?"

dialogues.jp: ニヤリと笑って肩をすくめる。
dialogues.en: I grinned and shrugged my shoulders.
dialogues.text: I grinned and shrugged my shoulders.

dialogues.jp: 今はまだ、心に秘めていよう。
dialogues.en: I should keep this in my heart for now.
dialogues.text: I should keep this in my heart for now.

dialogues.jp: かすかな隙間を見つけるまで。
dialogues.en: Until I find a small crack.
dialogues.text: Until I find a small crack.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「可愛いお嬢さんだねって、おまけしてもらっ
　ちゃったよ」
dialogues.en: "He gave me an extra since I'm a cute girl."
dialogues.text: "He gave me an extra since I'm a cute girl."

dialogues.jp: フタが閉まりきらないタッパを抱えて笑う。
dialogues.en: She smiled holding the pile of octopus balls.
dialogues.text: She smiled holding the pile of octopus balls.

dialogues.jp: 「世辞だ」
dialogues.en: "It's called flattery."
dialogues.text: "It's called flattery."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ふんだ。いいもん別にお兄ちゃんに可愛いな
　んて言われなくたって」
dialogues.en: "Shut up. I don't need to be called cute by you anyways."
dialogues.text: "Shut up. I don't need to be called cute by you anyways."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……当たり前だ」
dialogues.en: "I know that......"
dialogues.text: "I know that......"

dialogues.jp: 胸を押さえて笑う。
dialogues.en: I smiled as I pressed my chest.
dialogues.text: I smiled as I pressed my chest.

dialogues.jp: 痛い痛い……。
dialogues.en: It hurts......
dialogues.text: It hurts......

dialogues.jp: 本当に。
dialogues.en: Really bad.
dialogues.text: Really bad.

dialogues.jp: 「かったりぃなぁ」
dialogues.en: "What a pain."
dialogues.text: "What a pain."

dialogues.jp: ◆音夢を求める◆
dialogues.en: ◆Desiring Nemu◆
dialogues.text: ◆Desiring Nemu◆

dialogues.jp:
それでも俺は、音夢を諦めることが出来なかっ
た。
dialogues.en: I just couldn't give her up.
dialogues.text: I just couldn't give her up.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、それは音夢の命を奪うかも知れない行為
であり想いである……。
dialogues.en: But that feeling might take her life away......
dialogues.text: But that feeling might take her life away......

dialogues.jp:
もう少しだけ、せめて一筋の光明を見出せるま
では、俺の心に秘めておくべき想いだった。
dialogues.en:
I need to keep these feelings to myself until I can find a
small light of hope.
dialogues.text:
I need to keep these feelings to myself until I can find a
small light of hope.
